summary:
Implementation plan for:
1. Dual-Path Real Mobile App Launcher: Prioritizes launching native Android device apps via Android Intents/Deep links (vnd.youtube://, whatsapp://, intent:// schemes), with instant seamless fallback to on-screen interactive viewports if running in browser/desktop or app is not installed.
2. Auto-Mute Call & Conversation Detector: Automatically mutes speech, pauses microphone processing, and enters 'CALL_MUTED' mode during phone calls or active conversation, with automatic smooth reactivation back to 'LISTENING' when the call or conversation finishes.
